name: Орбитальный удар
subject: A heavy pointed brass-and-iron fantasy siege projectile falls vertically from upper centre, trailing short pale gold fire, toward a large expanding orange/white impact burst below. One descending projectile, strong overhead-to-impact read, a small ember corona remains at base. Detailed pixel metal plates and teal runic band; no modern missile fins, radioactive symbol, mushroom cloud, planet or futuristic tech. Dark navy with restrained warm glow.
caption: Удар сверху: тяжёлый снаряд и огненный акцент в области попадания.
